subject: Logic
title: Non-Classical Logics
description: A short lesson to help you apply Non-Classical Logics.

hook.text: What if true and false aren't the only options? Several logics throw out the binary.

buildup.text: Three-valued logic adds "unknown." Fuzzy logic allows partial truth. Intuitionistic logic rejects excluded middle.

discovery.text: Fuzzy logic powers washing machines and cruise control—situations where "somewhat true" is more useful than binary.

twist.text: Quantum logic challenges even basic rules: in quantum mechanics, distribution laws can fail.

climax.text: Classical logic isn't wrong—it's just one system. Different domains need different logical tools.
